messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Propose ONE conjecture in response.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "An optimal configuration of 13 points in the unit square, maximizing the smallest triangle area among all 286 triples, is a $3 \\times 3$ grid with vertices and edge-midpoints on the boundary plus the center point $(1/2, 1/2)$, augmented by two interior points at $(1/3, 1/2)$ and $(2/3, 1/2)$, achieving a minimum triangle area of $1/108$. The binding constraint arises from degenerate-near collinear triples along the horizontal midline, and no 13-point configuration can exceed this value."}
